usage.callShape: GET https://x402.orth.sh/scrapecreators/v1/truthsocial/user/posts?user_id=107780257626128497&trim=true (no body; pass handle OR user_id as query param)
usage.outputShape: body.success (bool), body.posts[] (each with .id, .text, .created_at, .url, .replies_count, .reblogs_count, .favourites_count, .media_attachments[]), body.next_max_id (pagination cursor), body.credits_remaining
quirks: GET endpoint, NO request body. Identity must be passed as a query param.

You MUST supply handle (Truth Social username) OR user_id (numeric, faster) — neither is strictly 'required' in schema but you get nothing useful without one. Trump's user_id is 107780257626128497; his handle is realDonaldTrump.
user_id comes from the 'id' field of the profile endpoint and is faster than handle.
Add &trim=true to get a smaller response. Paginate with next_max_id from the previous response.
Price is fixed 0.02 USDC on Base despite registry showing 'Varies'.
usage.guide: Call GET https://x402.orth.sh/scrapecreators/v1/truthsocial/user/posts with a query string identifying the account: either ?handle=<username> or ?user_id=<numeric id> (user_id is faster; it's the 'id' from the profile endpoint). No request body. Pay 0.02 USDC via x402 on Base. Read posts from body.posts[] (each has text, created_at, url, and engagement counts). To page further, pass ?next_max_id=<value> taken from the previous response's body.next_max_id. Add &trim=true for a lighter payload.
